title: Countertop Soap Dispenser 5-Ounce Solid Brass Waverly Place Collection | Spanish Gold | Allied Brass
short_title: Countertop Soap Dispenser 5-Ounce | Allied Brass, Spanish Gold
description:
Upgrade your bathroom counter with a space-saving soap dispenser featuring a generous 5 ounce bottle and solid brass construction in Spanish Gold, which presents a rich, warm golden tone with European-inspired elegance, bringing luxury and sophistication to distinguished bathrooms. Designed for soap, lotion, or hand sanitizer, it adds coordinated style to vanities and sink areas in the Waverly Place collection.

Highlights:
- Spanish Gold elevates the room with luxe gold tones
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Crafted from solid brass for enduring everyday use
- Traditional design with classic elements for versatile bath accessories
-  to coordinate with transitional bathroom hardware
